doctrine: YOU, CHAT and IDE are three LENSES over one HIDE session. They differ in default context and default permissions. They do not differ in intelligence, memory, or truth. The failure this contract exists to prevent is a fourth intelligence silo wearing a third tab.

YOU.not_called: Personal, in primary navigation, unless usability testing proves it clearer

shared_singletons.law: exactly one of each, per session. A surface that constructs its own is a bug, and the type system should make it awkward.

handoff_capsules.law: Every transfer between surfaces creates a TYPED capsule, never a flattened transcript. A transcript loses which claims were verified, which memory was consulted, and which permissions were granted -- exactly what the receiving surface needs.

kinds.carries: an implementation campaign: goal, constraints, prior research with its evidence tiers, decisions and why, explicitly out-of-scope items
a repository/worktree and verification plan: branch, files in play, tests that must pass, what reviewers should look at
a release summary: what changed, what was verified, what remains, and a personal/project update

every_capsule_carries: evidence tiers of any claim it asserts
the permissions it was created under
what it deliberately excludes and why
handoff_capsules.invariant: a capsule never widens permission. Receiving a capsule in CHAT does not grant CHAT the connector access YOU held when it was created. The capsule carries the CLAIM, never the CAPABILITY.

session_types.note: each declares default model/profile, context policy, memory policy, connector access, tool permissions, agent budget, persistence, retention and network policy; the user may override explicitly

memory_scopes_added_for_YOU.law: scope is orthogonal to class. A record has exactly one class and exactly one scope. Connector-scoped content never becomes global without an explicit, recorded promotion.

privacy_modes.local_offline: no network for any subsystem; connectors refuse rather than queue
privacy_modes.network_disabled: research and connectors refuse; local tools continue
privacy_modes.connector_disabled: network permitted for research, connectors refuse
privacy_modes.ephemeral_no_memory: working memory only; nothing durable is written, and the session leaves no episodic trace
privacy_modes.encrypted_vault: private_vault scope encrypted at rest where the platform supports it
privacy_modes.law: modes are enforced at the capability boundary, not by asking a subsystem to behave. A network-disabled session must not be able to construct a network-capable connector handle at all.

user_controls_over_memory.law: no hidden permanent memory. Every durable record is reachable by inspect and removable by forget, and forget is real deletion for user-scoped data rather than a tombstone.

what_is_deliberately_not_decided_here: the visual design of any surface -- that is a later Vision MCP campaign and this contract is fixture-driven so it can be inspected and iterated then
which model serves YOU -- routing is an enhancement; YOU must remain usable with a single General model

hard_constraint_inherited_from_the_wider.no_model_currently_qualifies: the only packed flagship artifact, GLM-5.2-H0.98-Math-Preserve, is semantically collapsed and REFUSED in odyssey/launch/SUBSTRATE_CAPABILITY.json. YOU's backend can and should be built and tested against fixtures and test providers, and it must not be described as a working personal AI until a capable model exists to serve it.
hard_constraint_inherited_from_the_wider.grade_ceiling_for_this_campaign: READY_FOR_INTEGRATION. Fixtures and mocks never earn PRODUCTION.
